principles: Each requirement explains which user goal it serves and names observable acceptance checks; validate intent against those goals during review.

For a UI, use designing-products before implementation. Pin the approved design with references.design (path and sha256); name PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, tokens and the blind judge disposition in the UI acceptance criteria.
Use the existing Spec Tree for any project: seed with hub prd grill and hub spec init; once spec.lock exists, change intent through a checked changes/C-NNN.json delta and cite Req:/Task: in delivery.
